text:
Anya (Growth): Quick idea 12 run a 2-week mini-surge: tiny credits + creative "hook" emails to see which onboarding narrative drives fastest product-first usage. Target: webinar signups + trial starters (n=450).

Liam: Nice. What are the hook variants?

Anya (Growth): Three hooks: 1) 'Build in 5' (templates to ship a feature fast), 2) 'Copy in Seconds' (marketing first), 3) 'Docs-to-Digest' (summaries). 40 tokens each, TTL=7d.

Jess: I'll assemble 3 prompt packs matching hooks and 2 email subject variants each. Short in-console banners too.

Samir: Routing: tag cohorts `hooks_web` and `hooks_trial`. Exclude paid and recent-credit-30d. I'll ensure no overlap with active campaigns. Posting config to #eng-infra after review.

Maya: Metrics: primary = pct with >=2 product-facing requests by day7. Secondary = avg tokens/use and day14 retention. Also measure time-to-first-request. @data-bot pull baseline for the cohorts (30d).
data-bot: Query queued: hooks_activation_baseline. Link saved to internal dash. ETA 25m.

Liam: Measurement: randomize assignment to hooks and to email subject variants. Capture UIs used (console vs API).

Anya (Growth): Budget & rollout: 450 * 40 = 18k tokens. If top hook > 12% lift, scale to 2k users. Owners: Anya (lead), Jess (creative), Samir (routing), Maya (analysis).

Jess: Will upload packs and Figma mocks by EOD. International copy EN/ES ready for A/B.

Samir: Draft config:
```
experiment: hooks_mini_surge_v1
cohorts: ["hooks_web","hooks_trial"]
credit_amount: 40
ttl_days: 7
exclusions: ["paid_customer","credit_30d","other_active_credit_experiment"]
```
Posting to infra now.

Maya: I'll build the dashboard and set alert if activation < baseline. Also prepare small qualitative probe for 30 users on day3.

Anya (Growth): Check-in Friday 11am PT. Ping if overlap with other launches. Rolling Monday pending infra signoff. :rocket:
